families.source: Home Office and GOV.UK workplace fire-safety guidance
families.topic: responsible-person duties, fire-risk assessment and evacuation planning for non-domestic premises
families.evidence_requirements: Fire-safety duties depend on the premises use, occupancy, building layout, responsible-person arrangements, hazards, vulnerable people and current control condition.

families.source: HSE electrical safety at work guidance
families.topic: electrical hazards, maintenance, safe isolation, competent inspection and residual-current protection
families.evidence_requirements: Electrical risk requires evidence about voltage, current path, environment, equipment condition, earthing, protection devices, isolation and the exact task.

families.topic: avoiding confined-space entry, safe systems of work and emergency arrangements
families.evidence_requirements: Confined-space risk requires evidence about geometry, access, atmosphere, residues, process connections, isolation, ventilation, work method and rescue capability.

families.topic: separation of pedestrians and vehicles, safe sites, safe vehicles, competent drivers and transport risk assessment
families.evidence_requirements: Transport risk requires evidence about site layout, traffic volume, vehicle type, visibility, speed, pedestrian behaviour, loading activity, maintenance and driver competence.

families.source: HSE Dangerous Substances and Explosive Atmospheres Regulations guidance
families.topic: control of fire, explosion and metal-corrosion risks from dangerous substances
families.evidence_requirements: DSEAR applicability requires evidence about substance classification, quantity, temperature, pressure, release scenario, ventilation, ignition sources, process and exposed people.

families.topic: safe operating limits, written schemes of examination, competent persons and maintenance
families.evidence_requirements: Pressure-system risk requires evidence about fluid, pressure, temperature, stored energy, equipment design, protective devices, condition, maintenance and operating limits.

families.source: HSE LOLER and lifting-equipment examination guidance
families.topic: planning lifting operations, equipment suitability, thorough examination and defect reporting
families.evidence_requirements: Lifting risk requires evidence about the load, equipment, accessories, configuration, ground, environment, operator, lift plan, supervision and examination history.

families.topic: suitability, maintenance, inspection, guarding, isolation, information and training for work equipment
families.evidence_requirements: PUWER controls depend on the specific equipment, intended use, installation, environment, deterioration mechanisms, guarding, maintenance and user competence.

families.source: HSE Work at Height Regulations guidance
families.topic: planning, supervision, competence, equipment selection and fall-risk control
families.evidence_requirements: Fall risk requires evidence about task height, duration, surface, edges, openings, fragility, weather, access, equipment, rescue planning and worker competence.

families.topic: reportable work-related deaths, specified injuries, diseases and dangerous occurrences
families.evidence_requirements: RIDDOR applicability requires evidence about the exact event, work relationship, injured person, diagnosis, outcome, timing and regulatory category.
